manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A blue motion arrow changes while a gravity arrow stays the same.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises from a launch mark and falls back. The blue arrow shows velocity and vanishes at the top. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const v=u-g*t;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const ta=u/g;const ah=u*u/(2*g);const eps=0.004;const st=Math.abs(t-ta)<eps?1:(t<ta?0:2);const labels=['Moving up','Still for an instant','Moving down'];const gy=380,sc=50;const by=gy-h*sc*(60/50)*1;const bx=250;const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({id:'lane.toss',x:10,y:34,w:620,h:370,title:'Ball toss',state:labels[st]}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',120,gy,380,gy,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.l',125,gy+14,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',bx,by-14,28,{role:'observed'}));if(st!==1)o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:bx+40,y:by-14},{value:v,direction:'up'},{scale:14,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:bx-40,y:by-14},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:4,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(430,150,[labels[st],'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return {frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:labels[st]},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:ah,velocity:v,height:h}};}
